title: config/ui-config.json
description: Defaults for the observer interface. Presentation only: nothing here changes what the simulation computes. A viewer's own choices, kept in their browser, come first. Reset in the Layers panel returns the layers to this file.

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editors.

schema_version.description: The layout of this file. A launcher refuses one newer than it reads.

_about.description: What this file is. Not read by any program.

_help.description: Each editable value: what it means, what it accepts, its default. Not read by any program; ./launcher config docs writes it.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Theme (Appearance). Dark, light, or following each viewer's system. A viewer's own choice in their browser comes first. Accepts: "system" (Follow the system), "dark" (Dark), "light" (Light). Default: "system". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

color_vision.title: Colour vision
color_vision.description: Colour vision (Appearance). Palettes for road and severity colours that do not rely on telling red from green, or blue from yellow. Accepts: "standard" (Standard), "protanopia" (Protanopia), "deuteranopia" (Deuteranopia), "tritanopia" (Tritanopia), "monochrome" (Monochrome). Default: "standard". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

reduce_transparency.title: Reduce transparency
reduce_transparency.description: Reduce transparency (Appearance). Solid surfaces instead of glass. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

high_contrast.title: High contrast
high_contrast.description: High contrast (Appearance). Text at full strength, firmer edges and outlines. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

advanced.title: Specialist detail
advanced.description: Specialist detail (Appearance). Off, measures meant for specialists (identifiers, hashes, coordinates) give way to plain language. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

reduce_motion.title: Reduce motion
reduce_motion.description: Reduce motion (Appearance). Short fades instead of movement. Following the system uses each viewer's own setting. Accepts: "auto" (Follow the system), "on" (On), "off" (Off). Default: "auto". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

enabled.title: Notifications
enabled.description: Notifications (Notifications). What happens in the simulation appears over the map as it happens. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

dnd.title: Do Not Disturb
dnd.description: Do Not Disturb (Notifications). Notifications are kept in history without being shown. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

important_first.title: Important first
important_first.description: Important first (Notifications). An alert goes ahead of what is waiting to be shown. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

max_visible.title: Shown at once
max_visible.description: Shown at once (Notifications). How many notifications the capsule holds before it groups the rest. Accepts: a whole number from 1 to 8. Default: 3. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

dwell_ms.title: Shown for
dwell_ms.description: Shown for (Notifications). How long a notification stays before it gives way. Accepts: a whole number from 1000 to 60000 ms. Default: 7000. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

mode.title: Auto Focus
mode.description: Auto Focus (Auto Focus). Whether the camera follows what matters: offered once per run, on, or off. Accepts: "enable-force" (On), "enable" (Offer once per run), "disable" (Off). Default: "enable-force". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

strategy.title: Order
strategy.description: Order (Auto Focus). Which event the camera shows: each in turn, or always the latest. Accepts: "round-robin" (Each in turn), "latest" (The latest). Default: "round-robin". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

dwell_seconds.title: Stays for
dwell_seconds.description: Stays for (Auto Focus). How long the camera stays on one event before the next, in turn. Accepts: a number from 2 to 120 s. Default: 9. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

zoom.title: Closeness
zoom.description: Closeness (Auto Focus). How close the camera goes to an event: 1 frames it, more goes closer. Accepts: a number from 0.2 to 8 ×. Default: 1.6. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

skip_seconds.title: Back and Forward jump
skip_seconds.description: Back and Forward jump (Playback controls). How far the observer's Back and Forward buttons, and J and L, go. Accepts: 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes), 900 (15 minutes), 1800 (30 minutes), 3600 (1 hour). Default: 900. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

step_seconds.title: Step
step_seconds.description: Step (Playback controls). How far Step, and K, advance before holding. Accepts: 1 (1 second), 10 (10 seconds), 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes). Default: 60. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

fine_control.title: Ask how far
fine_control.description: Ask how far (Playback controls). Back and Forward open a menu of distances each time, instead of one jump. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

hour12.title: 12-hour clock
hour12.description: 12-hour clock (Clock, units and news). Times as 3:00 PM instead of 15:00. Holding the clock switches it at any time. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

byte_units.title: Data sizes
byte_units.description: Data sizes (Clock, units and news). Decimal (kB, MB, as drives are sold) or binary (KiB, MiB, as memory is counted). Accepts: "decimal" (Decimal (MB)), "binary" (Binary (MiB)). Default: "decimal". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

label_language.title: Names on the map
label_language.description: Names on the map (Clock, units and news). Roads and places in this language where OpenStreetMap has their name in it (name:xx), and as the map names them otherwise. Display only: it never changes which city a seed chooses, or any hash. Accepts: "local" (As the map names them), "en" (English), "fr" (French), "de" (German), "es" (Spanish), "it" (Italian), "pt" (Portuguese), "nl" (Dutch), "ru" (Russian), "ar" (Arabic), "hi" (Hindi), "ja" (Japanese), "ko" (Korean), "zh" (Chinese), "tr" (Turkish). Default: "local". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

style.title: News style
style.description: News style (Clock, units and news). Realistic News, written by a model where one is available, or the standard plain lines. Accepts: "realistic" (Realistic), "standard" (Standard). Default: "realistic". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

roads.title: Roads
roads.description: Roads (Map layers). Shown when a viewer first opens the observer; each can change their own. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

traffic.title: Traffic
traffic.description: Traffic (Map layers). Roads coloured by how congested they are. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

vehicles.title: Flow markers
vehicles.description: Flow markers (Map layers). Vehicles moving along the roads. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Signals (Map layers). Signalled junctions and their phases. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

buildings.title: Buildings and places
buildings.description: Buildings and places (Map layers). Footprints, and the places that draw traffic. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

place_names.title: Place names
place_names.description: Place names (Map layers). Names beside places, as there is room. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

other_places.title: Unclassified places
other_places.description: Unclassified places (Map layers). Places with no kind of their own. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

labels.title: Street names
labels.description: Street names (Map layers). Names along the roads. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Weather (Map layers). Rain cells as they cross the district. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

flooding.title: Flooding
flooding.description: Flooding (Map layers). Roads under water. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: Incidents (Map layers). Collisions, breakdowns and closures. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

events.title: Demand
events.description: Demand (Map layers). Places drawing extra traffic now. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

enabled.title: Tutorial
enabled.description: Tutorial (Tutorial). The guided tour is offered from the header. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

show_on_startup.title: Show at start-up
show_on_startup.description: Show at start-up (Tutorial). The tour opens by itself, once, when a viewer first arrives. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

enabled.title: Report how it keeps up
enabled.description: Report how it keeps up (Backpressure). The observer tells the server how far behind it is, so Adaptive Simulation Backpressure can ease the rate before it falls behind. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.

report_interval_ms.title: Report every
report_interval_ms.description: Report every (Backpressure). How often it reports. Accepts: a whole number from 250 to 10000 ms. Default: 1000. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
